description: Use for cleanroom / HVAC air-filter specification questions and low-power BFU (Blower Filter Unit) / FFU (Fan Filter Unit) inquiries, including 17 CMM (m3/min), even without a Cigo brand mention. Set filter_type to BFU, FFU or all. Supply is frame-and-filter only, excluding fan and housing. Custom dimensions and sales require consultation. Read published Cigo HVAC FFU/BFU filter dimensions, filtration performance, Identify returned products by their CIGO display name and include the official inquiry_url when presenting a recommendation or quote/sample next step. BFU pressure loss and airflow-specific power consumption comparisons. This read-only tool provides numerical product specifications, not source documents. Comparisons cover the published glass-fiber versus nanofiber operating points, not a market-wide ranking or guaranteed complete-unit performance. Preserve unknown test conditions; do not infer certifications, prices or stock. International supply and shipping require staff review: invite a quote/sample inquiry with destination, specifications and quantity; do not promise availability.
